features.verdict: Unresolved typed-value interpretation, not counted as a confirmed conformance defect: Table 279 specifies /L,/V,/P as arrays and current code silently treats wrong-typed values as absent. §13.2.2 expressly makes an unrecognised value in MH non-viable, but the bad values are nested inside Table 278's special /C media-criteria dictionary, so this shard does not assume that the general MH wording necessarily applies at this nested level.
residuals: Draft is not compiled or run; use it to resolve whether a malformed nested Table 279 value is an unrecognised MH value or merely an invalid producer object outside the reader's required recovery behavior. Do not promote as a normative failure without that interpretation.

Table 279 /A,/C,/O,/S,/R,/D,/Z are conservatively unmet because the hand-off host exposes no user-preference, bandwidth, or monitor facts. This shard confirms the source-to-code rationale but does not certify every malformed value or criterion interaction.

features.verdict: Bounded source/code result: for this hand-off, every Table 294 option in MH is reported unhonourable and makes the rendition non-viable; BE entries are ignored, consistent with Table 293's 'should' and §13.2.2. This broad outcome makes most per-entry defaults unobservable in this product profile. Existing assertions are too sparse to substantiate the ledger's per-table claims; no valid-input contradiction was established in the reviewed path.
residuals: Table 294 F's conditional presence and Table 295 nested semantics remain assertion gaps; this audit does not promote missing F rejection because the relevant type/presence text may bind the producer rather than require reader rejection in this excluded-playback profile.
No full Table 304 tie/monitor selection is exercised; actual monitor selection belongs to excluded playback. The processor has no monitor fact in its Processor input.

scratchpad draft first_viable_selector_handoff.rs combines an MH-unknown non-viable first child, two later viable known-type children, exact xref offsets, and a public Event::Media handoff assertion for the second child; uncompiled/unrun
features.verdict: Interpretation unresolved, not a confirmed defect: Table 301 requires NU-listed players to be effectively removed from MU, but §13.2.7.2.2(c) gates on non-empty MU arrays and the standard does not explicitly state whether an array made empty by subtraction becomes absent. A physical non-empty MU may remain a whitelist whose effective set has no eligible player; alternatively, the Table 301 effective empty set could interact with the empty-array-as-absent rule. Current code's `must_use` tracks any viable MU element and does not represent PID/range subtraction. The source text alone reviewed here does not settle whether an unnamed hand-off is viable in the MU=NU case. Do not promote the prior expected-selection regression without stronger interpretation.
residuals: The old MU/NU fixture was replaced with drafts/first_viable_selector_handoff.rs, an unambiguous §13.2.2/§13.2.3.1 selector-plus-public-handoff regression; it asserts the second viable child is handed off and a third viable sentinel is skipped. Parent should review/run it.
The implementation does not compute or store MU-minus-NU PID/version ranges; whether that matters for this unnamed hand-off profile remains unsettled.
Complex partially overlapping version intervals, multiple dictionaries across clip and play parameters, and Table 302/303 match algorithms remain outside this focused counterexample.

scope_and_decision_notes: CLAUDE.md and doc/scope-ratifications.md put viability computed/reported, rendition-action handoff at the reader's restriction level, and media-file delivery in scope; decoding/presenting media remains excluded. This audit does not treat the exclusion as a reason to skip viability or handoff.
ADR 1960's unnamed hand-off profile is coherent within sampled scope. MU-minus-NU ambiguity does not yet establish an incorrect result for this profile.
ADR 1961 governs temporary-file restrictions at public handoff; unchanged by these findings. ADR 1946 scope boundary and ADR 2376 ledger classification remain supported at the reviewed boundary.
execution: No Cargo commands or tests run; parent owns execution and promotion.
parent_review: First-viable obligation located in §13.2.3.3, not .1. New public host-handoff test passes; sentinel payload does not assert playable MP4. MU/NU and wrong-typed nested criteria are unresolved; no red tests promoted.
